chapters.title: Work the Work (Reprise) / Mr Gruber's Shop

tracks.title: Work the Work (Reprise) / Mr Gruber's Shop

metadata.description:
Step into the heart of London’s West End with Paddington The Musical - Original Cast Recording, capturing all the warmth, wonder, and whimsy of the beloved bear’s latest adventure. 

Adapted from Michael Bond’s timeless stories and the award-winning STUDIOCANAL films, this brand-new musical features music and lyrics by Tom Fletcher, book by Jessica Swale, and direction by Luke Sheppard. From toe-tapping ensemble numbers to heartfelt ballads. 

Recorded with the full West End cast, this album brings the charm of Windsor Gardens straight to your home. Available on Yoto, it’s a joyful keepsake for fans of all ages - a perfect companion to London’s most loveable bear.
